sendEnv.source: const envFirst = (...ks) => { for (const k of ks) { const v = process.env[k]; if (v && String(v).trim()) return String(v).trim(); } return ''; };

gatewayEnv.source: function envFirst(...ks) { for (const k of ks) { const v = process.env[k]; if (v && String(v).trim()) return String(v).trim(); } return ''; }
